places.name: Imphal
places.note: Seat of government in the Meitei-valley heartland; repeated curfews and internet bans since May 2023.

places.name: Kangpokpi
places.note: Key NH-2 chokepoint; the epicentre of the 2026 Kuki–Naga escalation and a June 2026 attack that triggered CRPF COBRA deployment.

places.name: Churachandpur
places.note: Epicentre of the May 2023 violence; 1,557+ houses burnt here by May 23, 2023.

places.name: Tengnoupal
places.note: Overlooks the road to Moreh; a strategic corridor for the cross-border drugs trade.

places.name: Moreh
places.note: Porous transit town for Golden Triangle heroin & methamphetamines into India.

places.name: Jiribam
places.note: Manipur’s only rail link and the NH-37 (Imphal–Silchar) supply lifeline.

places.name: Ukhrul
places.note: One of five new Kuki–Naga tension zones in 2026; 50 houses burnt and a 5-day internet ban in February 2026.

places.name: Thoubal
places.note: Curfews and commercial shutdowns through the conflict period.

places.name: Senapati
places.note: A Kuki–Naga flashpoint in 2026; UNC counter-blockades here have repeatedly choked the NH-2 supply line.

places.name: Noney
places.note: Nungthut and Khongmol villages burnt here on July 8, 2026 in the widening Kuki–Naga violence.
